summary: San Francisco Bay Area resident, software engineer with expertise in Java, Ruby, and Node.js, former graduate student in humanities, strong advocate for economic equality and social mobility, critical of adjunct faculty system in academia, engaged in discussions about national debt and economic policy, interested in programming languages and their ecosystems, supports public transit and housing development, skeptical of rent control policies, believes in the importance of personal connections for job opportunities, critical of the academic job market, and concerned about the impact of student loans on education.
